s: A company has registered 10 new domain names. The company uses the domains for online marketing. The company needs a solution that will redirect online visitors to a specific URL for each domain. All domains and target URLs are defined in a JSON document. All DNS records are managed by Amazon Route 53. A solutions architect must implement a redirect service that accepts HTTP and HTTPS requests. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational effort? (Choose three.)
o: Create a dynamic webpage that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. Configure the webpage to use the JSON document in combination with the event message to look up and respond with a redirect URL.
Create an Application Load Balancer that includes HTTP and HTTPS listeners.
Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the JSON document in combination with the event message to look up and respond with a redirect URL.
Use an Amazon API Gateway API with a custom domain to publish an AWS Lambda function.
Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Deploy a Lambda@Edge function.
Create an SSL certificate by using AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Include the domains as Subject Alternative Names.

w.y: A serverless redirect service needs no servers to manage. A CloudFront distribution accepts both HTTP and HTTPS for all 10 domains. A Lambda@Edge function reads the JSON map and returns a 301/302 for the requested host. For HTTPS, CloudFront needs one ACM certificate (issued in us-east-1) that lists the domains as Subject Alternative Names.

o.A: Running an EC2 web server means patching, scaling and availability work, which is not the least effort.
o.B: An ALB could work with Lambda targets, but you manage a regional load balancer; CloudFront plus Lambda@Edge is the more hands-off pattern here.
o.C: Correct: the Lambda function holds the lookup logic that maps the incoming host to its redirect URL (deployed as Lambda@Edge).
o.D: API Gateway endpoints are HTTPS-only, so they can't serve plain HTTP requests, and each domain needs its own custom domain mapping.
o.E: Correct: CloudFront listens on HTTP and HTTPS for every alternate domain and runs the Lambda@Edge redirect at the edge.
o.F: Correct: one ACM certificate with the domains as SANs enables HTTPS for all 10 domains on the distribution.

s: Use alternate domain names and HTTPS - Amazon CloudFront
